description.value: El Furniture Warehouse on Granville is a casual restaurant and bar in Vancouver's Entertainment District, situated steps from the Orpheum and Commodore Ballrooms. The space features brick walls, neon lighting, and roll-up windows that give it an indie-show atmosphere, plus both a covered storefront patio and a summer street patio overlooking Granville Street. Part of the multi-city Warehouse Group chain, it serves a concise menu of burgers, tacos, poutine, and salads with vegetarian options throughout.
